summary: Two Harbors Investment Corp. filed an 8-K on June 23, 2026, announcing the adjournment of a special meeting of stockholders in connection with its proposed acquisition by an affiliate of CrossCountry Mortgage, LLC. The terms, including price per share, premium, and expected close date, are not specified in this filing. The board recommends the transaction, and the filing notes procedural adjournment. The deal structure appears to be a merger; advisors are not named. Watch for stockholder vote outcome and regulatory approvals to assess deal completion risk.
